messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated error rate on /v1/generate with high 'function_call' payloads. 90th p99 token latency spiking, lots of OOMs on quantized 8-bit variants. Auto-alert created.
maya: I'm on it. Can people avoid full incident threads in #general pls. samir + lee take primary/secondary for mitigation.
samir: grabbing logs now. Initial looks like a spike in agent-style requests with large tool schemas. KV cache churn is through the roof.
lee: adding context — customers using large tool definitions and structured JSON outputs. Memory per request up ~3x compared to normal. We're seeing backpressure on the runtime batching queue.
jordan: quick impact check: any user-facing 5xx? or just slow responses? ops-bot: slowed responses and some 502s reported by health checks in us-west-2. A handful of customers in high-traffic seats saw degraded throughput, nothing yet marked as outage.
maya: mitigation plan suggestion: 1) apply a canary limiter that reduces `function_call` concurrency by 60% for non-enterprise tenants, 2) gate structured output (structured=true) at the gateway for free and trial tiers, returning a lightweight fallback. Thoughts?
lee: +1 for gating structured by tier. Add a runtime flag to collapse >N tools per prompt into summary placeholders to reduce schema size.
samir: I can flip a traffic shaping rule. Proposed commands (testing in canary):

```bash
# temp reduce concurrent function invocations for tag=free,trial
redwoodctl rate-limit set --scope=tenant_tag:free,trial --route=/v1/generate --param=function_call --concurrency=0.4

# collapse structured outputs for oversized tool schemas
redwoodctl routing set --route=/v1/generate --header=Prefer-Structured:false --condition=tenant_tag in (free,trial)
```

jordan: running these in canary first. Will monitor p50/p95/p99 and error rates.
ops-bot: canary applied to 10% of traffic in us-west-2. Observability: p99 latency dropped 30% in canary segment, error rate down 45%.
maya: good signal. Next steps: rollout to 50% in 10m if metrics stable. Samir, prepare a quick customer-impact note — which customers hit the gating and what telemetry we surface.
samir: pulling list now. Early: 3 sandbox tenants, 8 small prod tenants on free tier, and 2 mid-market trial clusters. Will list request IDs and example payload sizes in the handoff.
lee: ops concern — disable tool calls completely? I'd prefer conservative reduction + structured gating first. Disabling entirely could break customers' agents badly.
maya: agreed. Avoid hard-off where possible. We'll use tiered policy: free/trial -> structured output fallback + concurrency cap; paid-enterprise -> notify and offer opt-in hard-off if they want protection.
jordan: rolling to 50% now. Keeping canary flag set. Monitoring dashboard -> https://console.redwood.ai/d/traffic/funcalls?panelId=23
ops-bot: 50% rollout complete. Canary segment health: p99 stable, errors down 40%. Overall cluster p99 improving but still slightly above SLO.
sophie: flag for comms — SREs should prepare a short status blurb for any customers pinging support: explain temporary structured-output fallback and reassure that enterprise tenants unaffected unless they opted in.
maya: samir if you can assemble the customer-impact snippet. Also add a note in the incident channel with which tenants had requests transformed so support can correlate.
samir: snippet ready:

"We observed transient memory pressure from large structured tool payloads which impacted latency for some non-paid tenants. As an automated mitigation we temporarily reduced concurrent function invocations and served a compact non-structured fallback for affected tiers. Paid/enterprise tenants continue to receive structured responses. We're monitoring and will revert gating when stable. If you need structured output immediately, reply to this thread with tenant id and we'll whitelist."

lee: +1. I'll keep watch on kernel OOM logs. If we see recurrence after broader rollout, we'll consider auto-quantization fallbacks or soft-eviction of large KV entries.
maya: timeline: now -> 50% rolled. 10m monitor window. 30m plan for full rollout or rollback. escalation: if p99 doesn't drop below 2.5s, escalate to oncall-sre for mitigation 2 (hard-off path).
incident-bot: Incident updated. Severity: elevated (S2). Owner: maya. Escalation timer set for 00:20:00.
jordan: current ask to oncall: please standby, we'll hand off at T+30 unless stabilized earlier.
ops-bot: telemetry note: a subset of requests had tool schema > 150KB; those correlate strongly with errors. Consider future defense: max schema size at gateway.
maya: thanks team. Keep replies short — use reactions where possible. Next update in 8m unless we need an urgent handoff.
